Ana (Partnerships): Heads-up: coordinating the hybrid partner showcase on Fri — CloudWave + NodeLabs + Redwood. Need final speaker order, two 8-min demos, and swag fulfillment cutoffs. Quick sync?
Devon (Events): I can grab 15 after lunch. Is the venue AV rack confirmed?
Sam (Field Ops): Rack booked. We have two spare HDMI capture boxes and a spare GPU node for local fallbacks.
Maya (CloudWave): I'll demo our streaming tokenizer. Need 8 mins and a 2-min Q&A. Can we slot me before hardware?
Omar (NodeLabs): My team wants 12 mins for the edge fallthrough demo (includes brief hardware attach). If we need to cut, I can trim to 8 but prefer extra 4.
Ravi (Solutions): Redwood will do an 8-min integration demo + 5-min rapid troubleshooting. I propose order: CloudWave -> Redwood -> NodeLabs -> Hands-on. Thoughts?
Lidia (Marketing): Sounds good. Swag note: partner co-logo hoodies (small batch), sticker sheets, pocket notebooks. Deadline for printing = Wed EOD. Shipping labels need finalized addresses by Wed noon.
Ana (Partnerships): @Sam please confirm shipping ETA and customs docs for EU partner kits. We had a hold last month.
Sam (Field Ops): On it. Two EU boxes flagged; carrier needs CN22 + commercial invoice. I'll ping logistics and attach docs by Tue 11:00.
Devon (Events): Run-of-show (first draft):
```
16:00 - Doors open / booth demos
16:30 - Welcome (Ana) - 5m
16:35 - CloudWave demo (Maya) - 8m
16:44 - Redwood integration (Ravi) - 8m
16:52 - NodeLabs hardware demo (Omar) - 12m
17:05 - Live hands-on (guided labs) - 12m
17:17 - Lightning Q&A & closing - 8m
```
Maya (CloudWave): If Omar needs 12m, can we shave 2m from hands-on or shorten my Q&A to 1 min?
Ravi (Solutions): We can shorten intro slides to buy 2 mins. I'll tighten.
Lidia (Marketing): Virtual audience: we'll gate a swag raffle to attendees who complete the post-event survey. Promo code for partner discount? I can generate a 1-time code per partner.
Ana (Partnerships): Nice. Also need final headshots + 30-word bios by Tue EOD for the event page. @Maya @Omar @Ravi
Omar (NodeLabs): Sending headshot now. Bio coming shortly.
calendar-bot: Reminder created: "Hybrid Partner Showcase rehearsal" Wed 10:00 PT -> https://zoom.us/j/222333444 (auto-invite to channel)
Devon (Events): AV checklist: OBS scenes needed: Lobby, Sponsor-Slides, CW-Demo, Redwood-Demo, NL-HW, Hands-On, Q&A. Who can verify lower-third assets?
Lidia (Marketing): Uploading lower-thirds and partner-approved logos to /assets/webinar by Tue 09:00. Please do not use any altered partner logos.
Sam (Field Ops): Fallback procedure for hands-on (if GPU pod busy): run local quantized binary with these steps:
```bash
# fallback start
./run_local_server --model rwinf-quant --port 9090 --threads 2
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9090/api/generate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: The demo flow is"}'
```
Ravi (Solutions): I'll prerecord a 3-min condensed demo as a backup and upload to the drive. Link: https://drive.redwood/repo/hybrid-showcase/backups
Maya (CloudWave): For the on-site lab, can we get 5 tablets loaded with the quickstart? I'll coordinate with Sam on images.
Sam (Field Ops): Yes, image build scheduled Tue 18:00. Who signs off on the UI copy for the tablets?
Lidia (Marketing): I'll review copy Thu morning. Quick ask: can we make the CTA on the tablet say "Try Redwood x CloudWave lab" (co-branded)?
Ana (Partnerships): Good. Logistics: speaker green room arrival = 15:00, mic check 15:30. Speaker swag packs to green room at 14:30.
Devon (Events): Can someone confirm we'll have remote hot-seat for remote speakers + ethernet patch? Last minute wifi drops are a pain.
Sam (Field Ops): Ethernet patch is reserved. I'll keep a spare wired laptop for remote fallback streaming.
Lidia (Marketing): Post-event follow-up: 48-hour email with recording, partner offer, and survey link. I'll draft and share for approval Wed. Also propose a blog co-post with partner quotes.
Ana (Partnerships): Rehearsal times: Wed 10:00 PT full run, Thu 13:00 short tech check. Please RSVP.
Ravi (Solutions): RSVPed. I'll bring the trimmed prompt deck.
Maya (CloudWave): RSVP.
Omar (NodeLabs): RSVP.
Devon (Events): Final action list: 1) Speakers send headshots + bios (Tue EOD) 2) Marketing uploads lower-thirds + copies (Tue morning) 3) Sam finalizes customs + shipping docs (Tue 11:00) 4) Rehearsal Wed 10:00 PT. Any blockers? :eyes:
